scope: Complete author reading of all five debugging pages, with source comparison of debug response exposure and AI-advisor enablement plus the existing scoped exception, query-tracing, AI-context and diagnostic-suggestion tests. This is not production monitoring, comprehensive redaction, provider diagnosis, or final candidate certification.

reviews.reason: Routes by failure type and immediately states debug exposure, tracing opt-in and experimental AI-assistance boundaries.
Separates HTML and JSON behavior, states that rich HTML is not loopback-restricted, and limits fixed-name masking without claiming authentication or monitoring.
Distinguishes process-global capture from contextual trace sessions, explains caps and timing, and treats SQL/parameters as unredacted private diagnostics.
Labels the advisor experimental and rule-based, explains its two-setting enablement and context exposure, and makes external sharing a separate reviewed action.
Describes fix plans as structured suggestions, preserves filtered versus unfiltered exit semantics, and does not claim commands or repairs execute automatically.
